900.3.10(10).explanation: Exception RD 10 replaces several RD zone standards: front yard setback of 3.0 m (lots under 30 m deep) or 4.5 m (30 m or deeper), rear yard 7.5 m (9.0 m backing onto Martin Grove Rd.), side yards of 0.3 m on one side with 1.2 m combined, maximum height 10.5 m and maximum lot coverage 45%, plus garage, flankage, easement, fence and building-separation rules we disclose but do not check.

900.3.10(236).explanation: Exception RD 236 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed in 2013 as the minimums, sets a 0.9 m side yard, a 3.6 m street side yard, a 6.0 m setback for garages whose entrance faces the street (0.3 m otherwise), and a 22.0 m setback from the Brimley Rd. road-allowance centreline.
